name: 任务详情编辑
desc: 查看与编辑在同一个「任务详情」弹窗里（行上无铅笔按钮）：弹窗面板已放大（.dialog-lg，>=700px）、编辑区是一个多行 contenteditable（每行一个块，**所有行样式一致，首行加粗加大那套已整体去掉**），打开时预填「首行标题 + 描述」；回车自己拆行、光标落在新行；点盒子空白处把光标放回编辑区；清空后自动补回可编辑空行；全空禁用保存；保存把多行拆回 text / desc 并关闭弹窗、列表同步落盘；关闭丢弃未保存修改；编辑不影响完成状态 / 分组 / 时间戳

steps.eval: if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.wipe = async () => { const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); sessionStorage.setItem('__todo_store_id', JSON.stringify({ id: 'conjure-todo-app-test', exp: Date.now() + 600000 })); const K = '__todo_test_backup_v1'; if (localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_dirty') === '1') { const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(K) || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } } const snap = { todos: await s.getItem('todos'), groups: await s.getItem('groups'), ui: await s.getItem('ui') }; localStorage.setItem(K, JSON.stringify(snap)); localStorage.setItem('__todo_test_dirty', '1'); await s.removeItem('todos'); await s.removeItem('groups'); await s.removeItem('ui'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'wiped, backup todos=' + (snap.todos ? snap.todos.length : 0); }; return await T.wipe();

if (typeof T === 'undefined') { window.T = {}; } T.q = (s) => { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); const r = p && p.shadowRoot; return r ? Array.from(r.querySelectorAll(s)) : []; }; T.ready = async (sel, ms) => { const n = Math.ceil((ms || 3000) / 100); for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (T.q(sel).length) return true; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } throw new Error('页面就绪超时，找不到 ' + sel); }; T.tx = (el) => el.textContent.trim(); T.click = (el) => { if (!el) throw new Error('元素不存在'); const b = el.shadowRoot && el.shadowRoot.querySelector('button'); (b || el).click(); return true; }; T.byText = (sel, t) => T.q(sel).find((e) => T.tx(e) === t) || null; T.btn = (t) => T.click(T.byText('st-button', t)); T.dlg = () => T.q('st-dialog').find((d) => d.hasAttribute('open')) || null; T.dlgBtn = (t) => { const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('当前没有打开的弹窗'); const b = Array.from(d.querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((x) => T.tx(x) === t); if (!b) throw new Error('弹窗里找不到按钮：' + t); return T.click(b); }; T.dlgHead = () => T.tx(T.dlg().querySelector('[slot=headline]')); T.panelW = () => getComputedStyle(T.dlg().shadowRoot.querySelector('[part=panel]')).width; T.wait = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms || 300)); T.items = () => T.q('.item'); T.item = (t) => T.items().find((i) => T.tx(i.querySelector('.text')) === t) || null; T.need = (t) => { const i = T.item(t); if (!i) throw new Error('找不到任务：' + t); return i; }; T.NL = String.fromCharCode(10); T.addTask = async (title, desc) => { T.btn('添加任务'); await T.wait(350); const d = T.dlg(); if (!d) throw new Error('添加弹窗未打开'); const f = d.querySelector('.dialog-field'); f.value = desc ? title + T.NL + desc : title; f.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await T.wait(250); T.dlgBtn('添加'); await T.wait(400); return true; }; T.toggle = (t) => T.click(T.need(t).querySelector('st-checkbox').shadowRoot.querySelector('input')); T.openDetail = async (t) => { T.need(t).querySelector('.body').click(); await T.wait(550); if (!T.dlg()) throw new Error('点正文应打开「任务详情」弹窗'); return true; }; T.editor = () => T.q('.rt-editor')[0]; T.esc = (s) => String(s).split('&').join('&').split('<').join('<'); T.setEditor = async (text) => { const ed = T.editor(); if (!ed) throw new Error('找不到富文本编辑区 .rt-editor'); const lines = String(text == null ? '' : text).split(T.NL); ed.innerHTML = lines.map((l) => '
' + (l === '' ? '
' : T.esc(l)) + '
').join(''); ed.dispatchEvent(new Event('input', { bubbles: true })); await T.wait(380); return true; }; T.lines = () => Array.from(T.editor().children).map((l) => l.textContent); T.lineStyle = (i) => { const l = T.editor().children[i]; return getComputedStyle(l).fontWeight + '/' + getComputedStyle(l).fontSize; }; T.saveBtn = () => { const b = Array.from(T.dlg().querySelectorAll('st-button')).find((x) => T.tx(x) === '保存'); if (!b) throw new Error('弹窗里找不到「保存」'); return b; }; T.caretTo = (lineIdx, off) => { const ed = T.editor(); ed.focus(); const line = ed.children[lineIdx] || ed.children[0]; const tn = Array.from(line.childNodes).find((n) => n.nodeType === 3); const r = document.createRange(); if (tn) { const o = Math.min(off, tn.length); r.setStart(tn, o); r.setEnd(tn, o); } else { r.selectNodeContents(line); r.collapse(false); } const sel = window.getSelection(); sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r); return true; }; return 'helpers ready';

await T.ready('.add-group-btn'); await T.addTask('写周报', '本周总结'); const it = T.need('写周报'); if (T.q('.edit-btn').length !== 0) throw new Error('列表行不应再有编辑铅笔按钮'); if (it.querySelectorAll('.item-actions st-icon-button').length !== 1) throw new Error('行尾操作区只应剩删除一个按钮'); await T.openDetail('写周报'); if (T.dlgHead() !== '任务详情') throw new Error('弹窗标题应为「任务详情」，实际 ' + T.dlgHead()); const pw = parseFloat(T.panelW()); if (!(pw >= 700)) throw new Error('「任务详情」弹窗面板应已放大（>=700px），实际 ' + T.panelW()); const ed = T.editor(); if (!ed) throw new Error('弹窗里应有多行编辑区 .rt-editor'); if (ed.getAttribute('contenteditable') !== 'true') throw new Error('编辑区应是可编辑的（contenteditable）'); if (!T.dlg().contains(ed)) throw new Error('编辑区应在弹窗内'); if (T.q('.edit-preview').length !== 0) throw new Error('不应再有框下方的预览行'); if (parseFloat(getComputedStyle(T.q('.rt-box')[0]).minHeight) < 150) throw new Error('编辑区盒子应更高（min-height >= 150px），实际 ' + getComputedStyle(T.q('.rt-box')[0]).minHeight); const lines = T.lines(); if (lines.join('|') !== '写周报|本周总结') throw new Error('编辑区应预填「首行标题 + 描述」：' + lines.join('|')); if (T.q('.rt-title').length !== 0) throw new Error('首行加粗加大那套已去掉，不应再有 .rt-title'); if (T.lineStyle(0) !== '400/14px' || T.lineStyle(1) !== '400/14px') throw new Error('多行时各行样式应一致（400/14px），实际 ' + T.lineStyle(0) + ' / ' + T.lineStyle(1)); const txt = T.dlg().textContent; if (txt.indexOf('分组') === -1 || txt.indexOf('状态') === -1 || txt.indexOf('创建时间') === -1) throw new Error('弹窗里应同时显示只读元信息'); if (T.saveBtn().hasAttribute('disabled')) throw new Error('有标题时「保存」应可用'); return 'ok：弹窗已放大、编辑区各行样式一致（无首行加粗）、元信息同屏';

await T.setEditor('只有一行标题'); if (T.lineStyle(0) !== '400/14px') throw new Error('单行应是普通字号：' + T.lineStyle(0)); if (T.saveBtn().hasAttribute('disabled')) throw new Error('单行内容应能保存（它就是标题）'); await T.setEditor('标题甲' + T.NL + '描述乙'); if (T.q('.rt-title').length !== 0) throw new Error('多行时也不应出现 .rt-title（该样式已去掉）'); if (T.lineStyle(0) !== '400/14px' || T.lineStyle(1) !== '400/14px') throw new Error('多行时各行样式应一致，实际 ' + T.lineStyle(0) + ' / ' + T.lineStyle(1)); await T.setEditor('只有一行标题' + T.NL + '   '); if (T.q('.rt-title').length !== 0) throw new Error('末尾换行也不应出现行级样式'); await T.setEditor(''); if (!T.editor().classList.contains('is-empty')) throw new Error('内容清空后应带 is-empty（显示占位提示）'); if (!T.saveBtn().hasAttribute('disabled')) throw new Error('内容全空时「保存」应禁用'); if (T.editor().children.length < 1) throw new Error('清空后应保留一个可编辑的空行'); await T.setEditor('标题甲' + T.NL + '描述乙'); if (T.q('.rt-title').length !== 0) throw new Error('多行时也不应出现 .rt-title（该样式已去掉）'); return 'ok：无行级样式、空态正确';

T.caretTo(0, 3); T.editor().dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { key: 'Enter', bubbles: true, cancelable: true, composed: true })); await T.wait(400); const lines = T.lines(); if (lines.length !== 3) throw new Error('回车应拆出新行，实际 ' + lines.join('|')); if (lines[0] !== '标题甲' || lines[1] !== '' || lines[2] !== '描述乙') throw new Error('回车拆行位置不正确：' + lines.join('|')); const sel = window.getSelection(); const an = sel.anchorNode; const anchorLine = an && (an.nodeType === 3 ? an.parentElement : an); if (!anchorLine || !T.editor().contains(anchorLine)) throw new Error('回车后光标应在编辑区内'); if (T.tx(anchorLine) !== '') throw new Error('回车后光标应落在新行（空行），实际在「' + T.tx(anchorLine) + '」'); await T.setEditor('标题甲' + T.NL + '描述乙'); return 'ok：回车自己拆行且光标落在新行';

T.q('.rt-box')[0].dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click', { bubbles: true, composed: true })); await T.wait(250); const sel = window.getSelection(); const an = sel.anchorNode; if (!an || !T.editor().contains(an)) throw new Error('点盒子空白处应把光标放回编辑区'); const line = an.nodeType === 3 ? an.parentElement : an; if (!line.classList.contains('rt-line')) throw new Error('光标应落在某一行内'); const idx = Array.from(T.editor().children).indexOf(line); if (idx !== T.lines().length - 1) throw new Error('点空白处应把光标放到最后一行，实际第 ' + idx + ' 行'); return 'ok：点盒子空白处也能回到编辑区';

await T.setEditor('标题甲' + T.NL + '描述乙'); T.dlgBtn('保存'); await T.wait(600); if (T.dlg()) throw new Error('保存后弹窗应关闭'); const i = T.need('标题甲'); if (T.item('写周报')) throw new Error('旧标题不应残留'); if (T.tx(i.querySelector('.desc')) !== '描述乙') throw new Error('描述应拆自第二行：' + T.tx(i.querySelector('.desc'))); await T.openDetail('标题甲'); if (T.lines().join('|') !== '标题甲|描述乙') throw new Error('重开弹窗应预填回来：' + T.lines().join('|')); await T.setEditor('不该保存'); T.dlgBtn('关闭'); await T.wait(500); if (T.dlg()) throw new Error('点「关闭」应关闭弹窗'); if (!T.item('标题甲')) throw new Error('关闭不保存时原值应保留'); if (T.item('不该保存')) throw new Error('关闭不保存不应写入新值'); if (T.tx(T.need('标题甲').querySelector('.desc')) !== '描述乙') throw new Error('关闭不保存不应清掉描述'); return 'ok：保存拆解落盘、关闭丢弃未保存修改';

T.toggle('标题甲'); await T.wait(400); await T.openDetail('标题甲'); await T.setEditor('标题甲（终）'); T.dlgBtn('保存'); await T.wait(600); const i = T.need('标题甲（终）'); if (i.className.indexOf('done') === -1) throw new Error('编辑不应影响完成状态'); if (getComputedStyle(i.querySelector('.desc')).display !== 'none') throw new Error('描述被删空后列表不应再显示描述行'); const meta = T.tx(i.querySelector('.meta')); if (meta.indexOf('默认 · 创建于') !== 0) throw new Error('编辑不应改分组与创建时间：' + meta); if (meta.indexOf('完成于') === -1) throw new Error('编辑不应清掉状态变更时间：' + meta); return 'ok：编辑不动完成状态 / 分组 / 时间戳；描述可为空';

let root = null; for (let i = 0; i < 30; i++) { const p = document.querySelector('o-page'); root = p && p.shadowRoot; if (root && root.querySelector('.shell')) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } if (!root || !root.querySelector('.shell')) throw new Error('刷新后页面未就绪'); const items = Array.from(root.querySelectorAll('.item')); if (items.length !== 1) throw new Error('刷新后应有 1 条任务，实际 ' + items.length); const i = items[0]; if (i.querySelector('.text').textContent.trim() !== '标题甲（终）') throw new Error('刷新后标题未落盘：' + i.querySelector('.text').textContent.trim()); if (getComputedStyle(i.querySelector('.desc')).display !== 'none') throw new Error('刷新后描述应为空'); if (i.className.indexOf('done') === -1) throw new Error('刷新后完成状态应保留'); if (root.querySelectorAll('.edit-preview').length !== 0) throw new Error('不应再有旧的预览行元素'); return 'ok';

const { getStorage } = await import('/nos/storage/main.js'); const s = getStorage('conjure-todo-app-test'); sessionStorage.removeItem('__todo_store_id'); const o = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('__todo_test_backup_v1') || 'null'); if (o) { if (o.todos) await s.setItem('todos', o.todos); if (o.groups) await s.setItem('groups', o.groups); if (o.ui) await s.setItem('ui', o.ui); } localStorage.removeItem('__todo_test_dirty'); sessionStorage.removeItem('todo-ui-state'); return 'restored';
